text: Items sent home by mail from a visit land in the same queue. Here's one from start to finish.
This one came from Juniper's visit today.
The doctor approved the directions on the bill, so there's no approval task.
It waits in Needs payment until the visit bill is paid.
A bill from the last hour may be a visit still going. Give it an hour before sending the client a pay link.
Once the bill is paid, it moves to Fill.
Fill it from the office you took it from,
print the labels, and mark it filled.
Then ship it: weigh the package,
Last, tell the client it's on the way.
The most common mistakes: filling a visit order before the bill is paid, and sending it to the doctor again when it was already approved on the bill.
Remember: visit orders are approved on the bill. They wait for payment, then fill, ship, check, and tell the client like any order.
